title: Global sections of a module on a scheme as a vector space over the base field
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $X$ be a scheme over $k$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base], with structure morphism $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$, and let $\mathcal F$ be a sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Define the $k$-vector space of global sections to have underlying abelian group $\mathcal F(X)$ and scalar action $c\cdot s=f^\#(c)s$, where $f^\#:k\to\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$ is the structure homomorphism. Equivalently it is evaluation of $\mathcal F$ at the whole space, followed by restriction of scalars along this homomorphism. No properness, smoothness, projectivity, coherence, or finiteness assumption is part of this definition.
